name: rorca-capture-vscode
description: Always-on Rorca context capture for VS Code-compatible editors using stable extension APIs.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Rorca Capture activates UI/status commands in untrusted workspaces, but event capture and submissions remain disabled until Workspace Trust is granted.

rorcaCapture.enabled.description: Enable Rorca editor/workspace context capture when the workspace is trusted.

rorcaCapture.workspaceId.description: Optional Rorca workspace id. Defaults to the first workspace folder name.

rorcaCapture.policyMode.description: Capture policy mode. Raw content is never captured unless explicitly imported or remembered.

rorcaCapture.queueMaxSize.description: Maximum queued events retained while the local Rorca API is unavailable.

rorcaCapture.memoryCandidateMaxCount.description: Default-on governance cap for explicit memory candidates sent from the extension.

rorcaCapture.memoryCandidateTokenCap.description: Default-on approximate token cap for explicit memory candidates sent from the extension.
